<thought>The isotopic pattern shows a strong M+1 peak (~20% of the base) and a smaller M+2 peak (~2%). This pattern matches the natural 13C abundance (≈1.1% per carbon) for a molecule containing many carbons, while characteristic patterns for Cl, Br, S, etc., are absent. Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed distribution is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
